company.name: Hulexo
company.shortDescription: Hulexo is a UAE-based retail technology company.
company.description: Hulexo is a UAE-based retail technology company that provides cloud-based ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) software for retail businesses. Their platform helps stores manage inventory, point-of-sale (POS), billing, customer loyalty, analytics, ecommerce integration, and overall business operations from one system.The company focuses mainly on small and medium-sized retail businesses in the Middle East, especially the UAE. Hulexo offers subscription-based ERP solutions designed to improve retail efficiency through real-time data insights and automation.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $1,200,000, or 86.96% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 1 disclosed grants total $30,000, representing 2.17% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,899,181 to $9,011,003, a 4.74x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
